sources.title: Qwen3 1.7B Base by Qwen (Alibaba) — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact base model that trades raw capability for efficiency — it handles straightforward language tasks with reasonable coherence but shows its size limits on complex reasoning or multi-step problems. sources.snippet: Qwen3-1.7B-Base Qwen3-1.7B-Base is a 1.7 billion parameter causal language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released in July 2025. It is a base (pretrained) model trained on 36 trillion tokens across 119 languages, featuring a 32k token context window and designed for inference efficiency on resource-constrained setups.
